scheme_name: One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)
other_conditions: Individual farmers registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme
Groups such as SKUS, PACS, FPO, FPC, FIG, SHG duly graded or approved/recognized by any Government Institution/Departments
A beneficiary or his/her spouse cannot apply for a new subsidy within four years of the last subsidy release for any machinery under OTA‑SFI
benefits_summary: Provides a maximum subsidy of ₹10,000 or 50% of the equipment price, whichever is lower, for manually operated farm implements.
documents_required: Print out of the application with acknowledgement receipt
